title: THIS PRICE DOES NOT MAKE SENSE!! (2025 TREK MADONE SL 5 GEN 8)

takeaways.text: A size-M SL 5 weighed 8.65 kg (19 lb 4 oz); it retailed at US$3,500 with 105 mechanical 2×12 and Bontrager alloy wheels.
He notes the SL 5 uses the same OCLV 500 Gen 8 frame with IsoFlow that Trek sells as a US$3,000 frameset, the same carbon as much pricier SL builds.
Hoses and cables run under the alloy bar and stem into the head tube, so headset service is more involved; clearance is 32 mm with 28 mm tires fitted.
It uses an inboard T47 threaded bottom bracket, so replacement bottom brackets must be the inboard type.

disclosure: GC Performance is a bike shop that sells Trek.
summary: A shop walkaround and weigh-in of the 2025 Trek Madone SL 5 Gen 8 with Shimano 105 mechanical.
